_comment: Maps each Sounds.json event key to one file inside the Kenney zips in assets/.
Picks were made by FILENAME ONLY - nobody has listened to these yet. Audition them
with `py tools/upload_audio.py --audition` and swap any `pick` you dislike for one of
its `alternates` before uploading. Open Cloud audio uploads are capped per month
(10 unverified / 100 ID-verified), so a bad pick costs a slot that cannot be reclaimed.
`ambient` entries in Sounds.json stay 0: these four packs contain no loopable music beds.

Village.source: OpenGameArt, RandomMind, 'Medieval: The Bard's Tale' loop version

uiClick.wants: short, dry, quiet tick - fires on every button press, so it must never grate

purchase.wants: single crisp chip/coin placement - the reward beat of the core loop

reveal.wants: soft thud as a building lands (spec 9); pairs under the purchase sound

levelUp.wants: short rising tick; pitch-shifted up per milestone, so it must survive +0.08 steps

levelUpMilestone.wants: brief bright flourish at levels 10/25/50/100 - stacks on top of levelUp

insufficientFunds.wants: soft negative blip, not harsh - players hit this constantly while saving up

eraAdvance.wants: triumphant fanfare under the era ceremony overlay - the game's biggest moment

rebirth.wants: grander than eraAdvance - rarer and more final; must read as a bigger deal

welcomeBack.wants: short friendly greeting on the welcome-back card - non-blocking, low volume
